verses.text: A psalm by David. LORD, I’m calling to you. Come quickly! Listen to my voice when I call.
Let my prayer rise before you like incense. Let my raised hands be like the evening sacrifice.
Set a guard over my mouth, LORD. Keep watch at the door of my lips.
Keep my heart from leaning toward evil or joining in with people who do wrong. Don’t let me share their rich food.
If someone who lives rightly strikes me, let me take it as kindness. Their correction is like oil on my head. Let me accept it. I’ll keep praying against evil deeds.
When their judges are thrown down the sides of the cliff, they’ll hear my words and know they were well spoken.
“Like soil broken up by a plow, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
My eyes are on you, LORD, my Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul with nothing.
Keep me out of the snare they’ve set for me, out of the traps of people who do evil.
Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I walk safely past.
